event: Tomás walks rear guard through a rain-scented root corridor, bow unstrung.
Tomás notes Dayo's posture has turned to discipline since her rest on the platform.
Tomás watches Miriam reading the whole party with Empathic Sense.
Tomás activates Terrain Read and maps a vaulted chamber with three elevated positions.
Terrain Read shows a twenty-meter boss embedded in the rear wall's root network.
Tomás reports the boss chamber fifty meters ahead; the party stops.
Solenne's look holds his a beat too long; both know what it carries.
Solenne asks for layout; Tomás describes the chamber and the boss's root reach.
Tomás assigns positions, taking the highest, Position 3, for himself.
Dayo considers the layout and nods without arguing.
Dayo crosses the threshold and the Thornweave Sentinel tears free of the rear wall.
Tomás perches on the root arch at Position 3, forty meters up.
Dayo in Iron Stance blocks two tendril strikes; Miriam's heal lands at once.
Solenne's Arcane Analysis finds a hidden mana node in the trunk's upper third.
Arcane Analysis Lv7 shows the boss's AI behavior, shared via Harmony Conductor.
Tomás nocks an arrow but holds his draw through Phase 1.
Tomás wonders if the Tower built the elevated positions for a Pathfinder.
Dayo holds center, pausing to read the space before each Shield Rush.
Nadia throws one of Vesper's Null Compounds at a weaving tendril cluster.
The Null Compound strips the cluster's magic armor for eight seconds.
Nadia calls the window.
Boosted by Vesper's Inscription, Solenne's Arcane Bolt severs three tendrils.
Tomás waits twelve minutes on the arch, holding his draw.
From above he watches Miriam healing steadily from Position 1.
He watches Vesper cycle inscriptions and consumables from Position 2.
He watches Dayo reflect damage with the Sentinel Gambit, positioned, not reckless.
He sees Solenne leading through the Conductor while carrying a hidden weight.
Solenne glances up at Position 3 in a lull; the look is not tactical.
Tomás thinks on the six Aspects being written into the Tower before Day Zero.
Tomás honors Solenne's request to wait, unsure it is right.
Phase 2: the Sentinel draws its roots inward, shrinking the space by forty percent.
Dayo's Shield Rush keeps a corridor open to Miriam.
Nadia asks Tomás to confirm a tendril anchor on the left wall.
Tomás confirms the Rootwhip trap anchor ties into the Sentinel's root network.
Nadia disarms the trap and turns its tension against the compression.
The System awards Nadia the Environmental Repurpose achievement, +100 XP.
Nadia's second Null Compound strips the trunk's armor; one is saved for Floor 10.
Solenne calls the node exposed and feeds Tomás coordinates via the Conductor.
Tomás draws his heavy bow and looses a Precision Shot.
The arrow hits the mana node; the Sentinel's Phase 3 enrage stalls thirty seconds.
Dayo Shield Rushes the trunk's base, destabilizing its root anchors.
Miriam's Thorned Ground pins the base tendrils, stopping regrowth.
Solenne channels Ley Conduit into an Arcane Bolt on the exposed node.
Nadia's thrown knife lands Stumble on the Sentinel's sensory cluster.
Dayo lands the final Shield Rush and the Sentinel's trunk cracks and falls.
The chamber shakes, the fungi flare and dim, and silence follows.
Floor 9 boss defeated: 800 party XP, Rootwood Core and Root-Walker Greaves.
Tomás climbs down and equips the Root-Walker Greaves; his steps go silent.
Miriam examines the Rootwood Core and feels it is Warden-attuned.
Miriam hands the Core to Vesper without discussion.
The All Secrets Found notice arrives for the cache Tomás found earlier.
The reward is a Burst Speed Skill Book, eligible for Nadia.
Nadia absorbs the Skill Book and says it will be ridiculous.
Nadia tells Tomás she will be the party's fastest for three seconds.
Tomás works out they'd be exactly equal at 33 AGI and keeps it to himself.
Party Record confirms Dayo's Anchor as a full-party passive tracking five.
The six stand in the amber Transition Hall before Floor 10's dark door.
Each stands with their gear; Solenne's staff bears the word designed.
Nadia looks at the door and says one more door.
No one answers; six Resonance Shards are warm.
Tomás doubts the silence he and Solenne keep but holds it.
All six wait at the door with the weight of what Tomás knows.
